beats.desc: a hand grips the loosened round stainless doorknob rose on the white door face and pulls it away, exposing the round bore hole with the brass latch mechanism inside
the hand drives a blue-handled screwdriver into the bore hole to release the old latch, and the freed latch mechanism begins to slide out of the door
beats.constraint: the screwdriver stays inside the bore hole and both hands stay at the doorknob bore.

subject: A man in a plain denim work shirt removes the old latch mechanism from the door bore with a blue-handled screwdriver, working with both hands; the man
scene_keep: the white door with its round bore hole on the front face, the stainless steel Defiant deadbolt latch faceplate mounted in the door edge to the right, and the bright sunny porch with a white railing behind
